---
title: "Exploratory Analysis"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.asp = 0.6)
theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))
```

```{r data import}
df = read_csv("data/liver_clean.csv") |>
  mutate(
    period = factor(period, levels = c("Pre-pandemic", "Pandemic"))
  )
```

## Cohort Characteristics

*TODO: descriptive table comparing pre-pandemic and pandemic cohorts.*
```{r monthly distribution}
df |> 
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(referral_month), 
    month = format(date, "%m") 
  ) |> 
  count(period, month) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = n, fill = period)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ period, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Distribution of Diagnosed Patients",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of Patients"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r HCC&ICC counts}
df |> 
  count(period, cancer_type) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = period, y = n, fill = cancer_type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_dodge(0.6), vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of HCC and ICC Counts Between Periods",
    x = "Period",
    y = "Number of Patients",
    fill = "Cancer Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() 
```

```{r etiology}
df |>
  count(period, etiology) |>
  group_by(period) |>
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = period, y = percentage, fill = etiology)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Etiology Spectrum Comparison Between Periods",
    x = "Period",
    y = "Percentage",
    fill = "Etiology"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired")
  
```

```{r tumor size & age}
ggplot(df, aes(x = age, y = tumor_size, color = period)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linetype = "dashed") + 
  facet_wrap(~ period) +
  labs(
    title = "Age vs. Tumor Size Trends by Period",
    x = "Age (Years)",
    y = "Tumor Size (cm)",
    color = "Period"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
df |>
  count(period, presentation) |>
  group_by(period) |>
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) |>
  ggplot( aes(x = period, y = percentage, fill = presentation)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percentage)), 
            position = position_dodge(0.5), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of Incidental Cases Between Periods",
    x = "Period",
    y = "Percentage (%)",
    fill = "Incidental Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


## Clinical Presentation


```{r satge&presentation}
df |> 
  filter(!is.na(tnm_stage), !is.na(presentation)) |> 
  count(tnm_stage, presentation) |> 
  group_by(tnm_stage) |> 
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tnm_stage, y = percentage, fill = presentation)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Presentations Across TNM Stages",
    x = "TNM Stage",
    y = "Percentage",
    fill = "Presentation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
```

*TODO: stage, tumor size, mode of presentation by period.*

## Treatment Patterns
*TODO: treatment received and time to treatment by period.*

```{r}
df |> 
  filter(!is.na(tnm_stage), !is.na(treatment)) |> 
  count(tnm_stage, treatment) |> 
  group_by(tnm_stage) |> 
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tnm_stage, y = percentage, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Treatment Distribution Across TNM Stages",
    x = "TNM Stage",
    y = "Percentage",
    fill = "Treatment Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") 
```

```{r}
df |> 
  filter(!is.na(period), !is.na(tnm_stage), !is.na(treatment)) |> 
  count(period, tnm_stage, treatment) |> 
  group_by(period, tnm_stage) |> 
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tnm_stage, y = percentage, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ period) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Treatment Distribution Across TNM Stages by Period",
    x = "TNM Stage",
    y = "Percentage",
    fill = "Treatment Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
```
- Orthotopic Liver Transplantation became harder during the pandemic.
